tonight.headline: Tuten missed Thursday too; Wilson limited again
body: Bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten did not practise on Thursday either (ankle/foot; CBS/RotoWire 12 Nov 16:23 ET), so two of three practices are gone and Friday decides it. Denzel Boston — Wilson's first cover — sat out Thursday too, though Monken calls it 'a little toe issue' (Yahoo/PFT 12 Nov). Garrett Wilson was limited again and is still in the concussion protocol (newyorkjets.com 12 Nov).

ESPN: 132.3 to 119.2, 56%. The lineup as set is still the projection lineup, so there is nothing to tap today. Isaiah Likely plays tonight at 19:15 CDMX with McCarthy off the injury report; Diggs, on the bench, locks with him. The two checks are Sunday at 10:30 CDMX: Tuten (if out, Warren to RB and Metcalf at FLEX) and Wilson (if out, Boston if active, else Metcalf).

case.label: The double-out script
case.body: If Tuten, Wilson and Boston all sit, Metcalf can cover only one slot: he takes Wilson's WR slot and Allgeier (8.7) takes Tuten's RB slot. Diggs is not an option — he locks tonight at 19:15 CDMX.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten full on Friday — then both checks shrink to Wilson alone. Boston full on Friday — then he is Wilson's cover again at 12.8 against Metcalf's 11.2.

whatWentWrong.title: Tuten's Sunday is now a Friday question
whatWentWrong.lead: A second DNP on Thursday; Friday's report sets the designation.

case.label: What changed
case.body: This morning he had one DNP; Thursday's report adds a second (CBS/RotoWire 12 Nov 16:23 ET: 'Friday's report decides his Sunday status'). In Week 9 he missed all three practices and still played, so a DNP week is not a ruling. Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) was limited again Thursday and is next up (NBC 12 Nov).

case.label: What it means here
case.body: The decision is already made in advance: active, he starts; inactive at 10:30 Sunday, Warren slides to RB and Metcalf takes the FLEX. Nothing to do before then.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Ruled out on Friday — then make the Warren/Metcalf move on Saturday rather than waiting for inactives.

whatWentWrong.title: Woody Marks hit the Chem wire — and missed practice the same day
whatWentWrong.lead: Bok-aneers cut him at 18:17Z; he did not practise Thursday and Montgomery returned.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Bok-aneers dropped Marks for Rico Dowdle at 18:17Z (activity log); he is on waivers, clearing Sat 14 Nov 02:00 CDMX. The same afternoon Marks missed Thursday's practice with the knee and David Montgomery practised for the first time since his groin injury (Houston Chronicle via Yahoo 12 Nov 20:03Z).

case.label: Why no claim
case.body: His 100% backfield share was Montgomery's absence, and both men's Sunday status is 'unclear' (Chronicle). There is also no seat: Etienne and Boston carry open theses that have not tripped, and Diggs and Allgeier are on the screen's exposure list.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Montgomery ruled out and Marks full on Friday, and Etienne not activated by Saturday 15:00 CDMX — but the claim clears at 02:00 Saturday, before that answer exists.
